$schema_note: amt-console design tokens, 2026-10-20. M3 TONAL_SPOT from the seed; the error palette is M3's error hue re-toned (light 40/100/35/100, dark 55/5/45/100) and the extended roles are own tonal palettes at the M3 custom-color tones, so that no value in either theme is pink, salmon, peach, coral or burgundy (see `predicates`). `pairs` lists every foreground/background pair the UI uses with its computed WCAG ratio; pairs with source=audit were found by walking the rendered mockups. Design artifact, not app code.

pink_magenta.rule: HCT hue in [300,360) and chroma > 10, at any tone
pink_magenta.applies_to: every color value, both themes, both tiers

salmon_peach.rule: HCT hue in [0,65) and tone > 65 and chroma > 10
salmon_peach.applies_to: every color value, both themes, both tiers

coral.rule: HCT hue in [15,65) and 58 <= tone <= 75 and chroma > 40
coral.applies_to: every color value, both themes, both tiers

burgundy.applies_to: every color value, both themes, both tiers

ring_hue_separation.rule: the chromatic status roles live, ok, error and primary are pairwise >= 60 degrees apart in HCT hue (circular), both themes
ring_hue_separation.applies_to: roles that paint a status ring, pill or chip

hold.note: 30% black over m3.error: the whole background of a destructive control while it is held (its label and progress bar are on_error_container)
30% black over m3.error: the whole background of a destructive control while it is held (its label and progress bar are on_error_container)

overlay.note: The only non-token color literals a mockup or the client may contain; the color-literal extractor allow-lists exactly these strings. disabled_fg is the M3 disabled label (on_surface at 38 %, WCAG-exempt); a disabled control keeps its outline at full alpha so the box can be found.

data.note: extended: fingerprints, addresses, hex, counts, next-boot flags; groups of 4 for a fingerprint

terminal.note: extended: the serial terminal and log raw data; user-scalable 12-20

consequence.note: extended: the plain-words consequence line of every write confirmation; never smaller than body-large

shape.note: force-control (the hold-to-confirm destructive control) is the only pill with a text label among the action controls; everyday action buttons are 8 px (small) rounded rectangles, so a destructive control reads as different by shape alone.

elevation.note: Dark theme uses surface-container tiers for elevation; shadows only on menus, dialogs and the confirm sheet.

breakpoints.phone: < 600 px: bottom navigation bar (Fleet, Manage, Images, Settings), server sections as a scrolling chip row, every panel a bottom sheet, server cards 1-up, tables card-per-row, no FAB (Add server in the app bar)
breakpoints.compact: 600-1099 px: navigation rail (icons + labels), server sections as tabs, cards 1-up below 840 and 2-up from 840 (a 2-up card at 600 is 232 px, too narrow for a key/value grid), tables in a horizontal scroller, the console view fills the width
breakpoints.full: >= 1100 px: navigation rail, server header + tabs, 3-up cards; from 1440 the console and serial views keep a 360 px side panel (session, input, media)
breakpoints.note: No horizontal page scroll at any width; 16 px side gutters; 328 px content at 360.

motion.reduced_motion: Every named animation resolves to animation-name: none and transition-duration: 0s under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce; elements carrying one declare it in data-motion (sheets carry sheet-open). The force hold keeps its 1200 ms (a safety delay), paints the whole control hold.fill and shows a 3-2-1 countdown instead of the progress bar.

consent_pending.label: consent code pending on the host

present_synced.label: present · synced from the main vault

intake_minted.label: intake minted · expires in <mm:ss> · value not received yet

live.label: status read <n> s ago · next in 30 s

paused.label: paused · credential refused (wsman_auth_failed_401 or pin mismatch); no further attempts until the identity is replaced or Retry once

mounted.label: mounted on <server> · Rename and Delete refused

downloading.label: <percent> · sha256 checked on completion · Rename and Delete refused

uploading.label: <bytes> of <size> · exact size and sha256 checked when the PUT ends · Rename and Delete refused

agent.stop: force control: stopping it ends the session under the agent's call

in_flight.strip: AGENT TYPING · your keys and mouse are paused until its call returns

ready.label: sha256 verified · saved to the capture store

expired.label: expired · the one-time link was not fetched within 15 minutes
